Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, intimacy coach and author Aili Seghetti joins Cyrus Broacha to talk about sex, relationships, desire and her new book ‘Buying Love in India'.
Aili explains why so many couples struggle to openly talk about intimacy, why mismatched libido can become a major problem in long-term relationships, and why most of the clients who come to her are men.
She also talks about orgasms, sexual dissatisfaction, cheating, ethical non-monogamy, polyamory, asexuality, kinks and how couples can rebuild intimacy after years together.
